feature: Source-visible side liquidity slices for asynchronous recorded-tick portfolio orders

regressions: Partial order quantity never exceeds the recorded displayed side size
Paired PRICE/TICK events do not replenish displayed size
Per-order fees account for submitted child orders
Independent report verification rejects altered fills beyond quote-side capacity
Existing single-instrument tick replay keeps its complete-liquidity gate
CLI exports the schema 1.1 report and verifies model identifiers

rollback: Revert the increment commit. No persistent state migration is introduced; previously exported schema 1.1 reports retain their original model declaration.
limits: Recorded top-of-book displayed size only; no deeper book or queue position
Declared event ordering is not measured network or venue latency
No exchange partial-fill acknowledgements, maintenance-margin model, or liquidation policy
Paper research only; no broker calls, credentials, order authority, or promotion permission
